fusions.name: Decree of Spores
fusions.desc: Fires a spore that deals 30 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds. When it hits, allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Final Verdict
fusions.desc: Strikes a target at or below 25% health up to 6 tiles away that deals 22 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Proclaimed Harvest
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 12 seconds and fights with 1 more power while it holds. You and your allies regain 8 health.

fusions.name: Court of Moulds
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage.
